platform_baseline.re-recorded_from: AnyWear-Infra final source synth (#158 step C extension)
platform_baseline.reason: The Workload consumer left this app, so the beta and prod Platform templates no longer contain the CDK weak cross-stack PublishOutput* outputs; the same re-record records the issue #161 recovery targets and the pre-split stage contract as template content instead of a permanent comparator allowance.

log_grant_rerecord.reason: The live Beta one-shot execution role keeps the awslogs CreateLogStream/PutLogEvents grant that AwsLogDriver.bind() appended while the Workload shared this app; the synthesized Platform policy now states it explicitly. These baselines were re-recorded from the same source synth and differ from the previous templates only by that one statement; dev has no one-shot execution role and is unchanged.

platform_baseline.dev_note: dev has no PublishOutput* output and no contract or recovery change; it is re-recorded only so the declared fixture Lambda asset location is recorded in the template and every Platform comparison is exact.
platform_baseline.move_anchor: The three Workload baseline templates deleted in #158 step C, and their byte-identical `move` proof from Infra 5c571cd, are recorded in AnyWear-Service's infra/test/baselines/provenance.json at its move-anchor commit; they are not duplicated here.

three_stack_split.reason: Beta becomes three stacks with disjoint lifetimes. The Base stack (AnyWearPlatformStack-beta, name retained) keeps the persistent VPC and its subnets plus each subnet's route table and association, Aurora, S3, Cognito, ECR, SQS, SSM and both CloudFront distributions, publishes api_base_url, and no longer carries NAT/EIP/default routes or the S3 gateway endpoint (moved to AnyWearEgressStack-beta, which adds only 0.0.0.0/0 routes into the Base-owned private route tables). All three Platform baselines were re-recorded from this source synthesis; the stopped Beta variant and its directory were deleted with the environmentRunning switch. Foundation and Billing remain the Service move anchor.

admission_retirement.reason: The tester allowlist is the only admission parameter: the mode parameter and its grants are gone, the PreSignUp trigger keeps the one read, PostConfirmation has no admission grant, PreSignUpLambda has a 10 s timeout, and the app client no longer reads custom:e2e_bootstrap. All three Platform baselines were re-recorded from this source synthesis for exactly those changes; Foundation, Billing and Runtime are unchanged.

scope: Source synth comparison only. Foundation and Billing templates remain the Service source move anchor; the Platform templates listed under platform_baseline were re-recorded from the final AnyWear-Infra source synth. Live Original CFN templates and physical inventories remain separate release gates. ZIP asset locations may differ from unchanged imported live bytes. The #166 three-stack split re-recorded only the Base (Beta Platform) baseline; Foundation and Billing still match the Service move anchor.

egress_identity_experiment.change: NatEip/NatGateway renamed to NatEipNext/NatGatewayNext so the next Egress update replaces the EIP/allocation and NAT and updates the two default routes; the EgressNatGatewayId/EgressNatEipAllocationId outputs keep their logical IDs/names, only values change.
egress_identity_experiment.baseline_bytes: No baseline bytes change: the synth matrix covers the application/Platform/Foundation/Billing scopes, not the egress-only Egress stack; the Egress Jest synth test is the identity assertion.
egress_identity_experiment.not_live_claim: The old physical IDs are the current observed values for the experiment record, not a deployed claim of this source revision; the new physical IDs are recorded at deploy.
egress_identity_experiment.revert: A revert replaces again and allocates another EIP.

egress_pinned_allocation.change: The stack-owned EIP is retained (DeletionPolicy/UpdateReplacePolicy Retain), and deploy-egress may take an optional retained allocation via the natEipAllocationId CDK context / NAT_EIP_ALLOCATION_ID workflow input. With the input the stack creates no EIP and the NAT/output use the provided allocation; without it a fresh retained EIP is created.
drill_flow: fix deploy: retain policy applied, no EIP replacement
egress_pinned_allocation.fallback: If the allocation is missing, deploy-egress without the parameter creates a new EIP and the provider probe must be repeated.
egress_pinned_allocation.baseline_bytes: No baseline bytes change: the synth matrix does not cover the egress-only Egress stack; the Egress Jest synth tests are the identity assertions.

normalisation: remove every resource Metadata key (only aws:cdk:path, aws:asset:path, aws:asset:property and aws:asset:is-bundled may be present)

identity_revision.change: Removed the BetaSizingTelemetry String parameter of AnyWearRuntimeStack-beta and the BETA_SIZING_TELEMETRY entry it fed in both Beta containers, together with the Service sizing observations that read it. The Beta Runtime baseline, its normalised beta/legacy, beta/roles-added and beta/retired phase hashes, its template sha256 and the beta identity phases were re-recorded from that source; the production template and prod phase hashes are unchanged because the parameter was Beta-only. The live check accepts this record's single accepted_live_predecessors entry as the transition's starting template, while the synthesized-identity check and the post-deploy read-back stay exact against the recorded roles-added identity.

runtime_identity.source_file_hashes: Git blob hashes of the current files at the #183 change head, in this repository's paths; they are not the 4f2ba555 move-anchor blobs. #195 compared the moved files with `git rev-parse 4f2ba555:infra/<path>`; after that anchor the #195 synthesiser change and later reviewed changes altered runtime-stack.ts, compute-runtime.ts, platform-inputs.ts and bake-gate.mjs, and issue #183 altered runtime-stack.ts, compute-runtime.ts and the Beta Runtime baseline. cleanup-operation.ts and the prod Runtime baseline still match their move-anchor blobs, so five of the seven entries differ from the anchor. source_sha above stays 4f2ba555ec293771551c0d23266af7038d95383e because scripts/synth-matrix.mjs asserts it as the move anchor, not as a claim that the current bytes equal it.
runtime_identity.note: The two Runtime baselines and the four Runtime source modules moved byte-for-byte from AnyWear-Service/infra at 4f2ba555ec293771551c0d23266af7038d95383e; that statement describes the move anchor only. The #195 synthesiser change replaced the retired own-credentials synthesiser with the standard cdk-hnb659fds DefaultStackSynthesizer, which changes the assumed principals and not the template bytes. After the anchor, runtime-stack.ts, compute-runtime.ts, platform-inputs.ts, bake-gate.mjs and the Beta Runtime baseline changed again; issue #183 accounts for runtime-stack.ts, compute-runtime.ts and the Beta Runtime baseline (removal of the Beta sizing-telemetry parameter and its container environment entry), so the beta phase hashes and the beta template sha256 in this record are measured from the #183 source (templates/, phase_hashes.beta, identity_phases and identity_revision). cleanup-operation.ts and the prod Runtime baseline still match the anchor, and the prod template and prod phase hashes are unchanged because the parameter was Beta-only. The legacy/roles-added/retired phase hashes are measured from source, not copied from the live stack.

live_verification.note: Analysis recorded the live roles-added phase at the same normalised hash; the operation asserts the synthesized hash before mutation and the deployed Original hash after deploy.

alarm_extension.note: The four #162 bake alarms and the worker outbox metric filter are part of the recorded Runtime baseline; they were the intentional additions to the post-#158 SSM form.

protection_extension.note: The WorkerTaskRole's default policy gains exactly one statement so the ECS container agent can set, refresh and clear task scale-in protection for the worker's own task. The resource is the cluster's task ARNs, built with Stack.formatArn from props.cluster.clusterName (an SSM-backed token on this base) rather than '*'; the worker task role is the only role that carries either action, and no other resource changes.
